name: Linker Hand O20
summary: Linker Hand O20 is LinkerBot's direct-drive dexterous hand with 16 independently controlled active degrees of freedom. The manufacturer describes brushless motors, ball-screw transmission and fingertip sensing for closed-loop position and force control. It is positioned for manipulation development, precision installation and specialized robotic operations. Its published specification lists an 888 g mass, CAN FD communication, ±0.2 mm repeatability and a 0.88-second opening or closing time. This record concerns the O20 configuration; the L20 and O30 use different mechanisms or actuation arrang
